readout_other: Microdialysis with HPLC-electrochemical detection of extracellular glutamate and GABA; hematoxylin and eosin histology for hemorrhage/tissue damage
direction_notes: Extracellular GABA levels decreased upon sonication and remained reduced (to ~82% of baseline) compared to the unsonicated control group, while extracellular glutamate levels did not differ between groups; the authors interpret the finding as consistent with an inhibitory/suppressive effect of the FUS parameters used.
safety_notes: Histological examination of transverse brain sections at the sonication focus and beam path showed no abnormal findings such as hemorrhaging or tissue damage.

timing.protocol_description: Microdialysates were collected every 20 min in a scheme of 3 baseline intervals (B1-B3), a single sonication interval (FUS), and 5 post-sonication intervals (P1-P5); the animal was sacrificed at the end of data collection without waking from anesthesia.

source_quotes.n_subjects: One group (n = 11) received FUS sonication on the brain (noted as ‘FUS’), allowing us to investigate the effects of sonication on the extracellular levels of glutamate and GABA.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Upon the completion of data collection, the animal was sacrificed without waking from anesthesia.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: An air-backed, spherical segment ultrasound transducer operating at a fundamental frequency of 650 kHz was used in the present study.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The following sonication parameters were used in the present study: 0.5 ms for the tone burst duration and 100 Hz for the pulse repetition frequency.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The following sonication parameters were used in the present study: 0.5 ms for the tone burst duration and 100 Hz for the pulse repetition frequency.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Similarly, degradation of GABA via GABA transaminase (and subsequent action of succinate semi-aldehyde dehydrogenase) is not likely to be immediately affected during the relatively short sonication period (i.e. 20 min) and thus may not explain the observed phenomena [thus rendering hypotheses (a) and (b) unlikely].
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: The maximum peak negative pressure associated with the selected tone burst duration and pulse repetition frequency was measured to be 0.35 MPa, resulting in a mechanical index of 0.2.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.isppa_w_cm2: The acoustic intensity at the focus was 175 mW/cm <sup>2</sup> in terms of spatial-peak temporal-average intensity, which corresponds to 3.5 W/cm <sup>2</sup> in terms of spatial-peak pulse-average intensity.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.ispta_w_cm2: The acoustic intensity at the focus was 175 mW/cm <sup>2</sup> in terms of spatial-peak temporal-average intensity, which corresponds to 3.5 W/cm <sup>2</sup> in terms of spatial-peak pulse-average intensity.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: The FUS sonication apparatus (Sonomo; SensMed, Framingham, Mass., USA), using the scheme described previously, is displayed in figure 1 .

flags.reason: 11 animals enrolled/exposed to FUS but one died during the experiment and one further animal was excluded for exceeding a 3 SD fluctuation threshold, leaving n=9 analysed; enrolled number (11) is reported here.
Not stated explicitly as 'one session'; inferred from the single continuous terminal procedure (baseline/sonication/post intervals followed by sacrifice).

Paper states the focus sonicated 'the ventrolateral and ventromedial thalamic nucleus'; ventromedial thalamic nucleus has no exact match in the target vocabulary, so only ventral_lateral_nucleus plus the parent thalamus term are given.
Peak negative pressure and intensities are stated already corrected for ~87% skull attenuation ('in situ'), so classified as derating rather than free-field.
